meaning: Line 253 splits the post-hydrostatic vertebral venous flow into two parallel return routes: through Rt and through the epidural branch (Hs_Revp -> Rivp/Revp -> Razy) that is loaded by abdominal pressure. It sets which resistances share the vertebral venous outflow and where posture-dependent hydrostatic columns enter the venous circuit.

could_move.what: Steady-state venous pressure and flow split between the transverse/Rt path and the epidural-azygos path, hence baseline operating point of model m3
Posture responses, since this junction feeds Hs_Revp and the abdominal-pressure-loaded branch at line 258
Cross-model comparison, where m3 is compared against m4
Bistability results, which depend on the venous return topology and could gain or lose basins

expectation: Unknown in size. Direction is not inferable from the context: adding or removing a parallel branch at this node changes total venous resistance, but I cannot tell the sign of the pressure shift without parameter values. Bistability is sensitive to topology, so effects may be qualitative rather than small.

check.why: Re-renders the steady-state m3 deck from a single solve instead of a full fit, so the baseline venous pressures and flow split can be compared against the previous figures.
